# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen years old (V4)  <sub>[v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v2 c23 P2](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston, Massachusetts  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c23 P2](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Paul has an exceptionally beautiful, delicate face with dark blue eyes, crimson lips, and chestnut curls, resembling his mother. He is small for his age at ten, though by sixteen he has grown tall, tanned, and sturdy, with his hair cut short. His face lights up with an illuminating, soul-revealing smile when he is happy.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c23 P2](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0002), [v2 c28 P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)_

## Personality

Paul is a deeply imaginative, sensitive, and poetic boy who possesses a vivid inner world of dream-people and fantasy. Though quiet, meditative, and intensely thoughtful, he is also manly, good-tempered, and well-liked by other children. He has a strong sense of duty, a deep affection for those he loves, and a frank, sweet manner of speaking his mind.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011)_

## History

Paul Irving came to Avonlea from Boston at the age of ten to live with his paternal grandmother, Mrs. Irving. At school, he instantly formed a deep friendship with his teacher, Anne Shirley, recognizing her as a kindred spirit who understood his rich inner world of imaginary 'rock people' and fantasy. During a severe bout of croup with Minnie May Barry, his father Stephen Irving brought Dr. Blair to help, though Paul remained at home under his grandmother's strict care. When Anne entered the Queen's preparation class, Paul continued to excel at school, writing poetry and compositions that impressed Anne. After Stephen Irving returned and reunited with his former love, Miss Lavendar Lewis, Paul warmly embraced Miss Lavendar as a second mother. Following their marriage, Paul moved back to Boston with his father and new mother. Years later, at sixteen, he returned for a summer visit to Echo Lodge and promised to visit Anne at Four Winds after completing two years of study abroad.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c23 P2](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0002), [v2 c23 P22](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0022), [v2 c28 P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 c28 P26](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0026), [v2 c28 P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030), [v2 c29 P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v4 c17 P26](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0026), [v4 c17 P28](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0028)_

> I like you, teacher.  <sub>[v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)</sub>

> There are a great many people who do not understand things so there is no use in telling them.  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041)</sub>

> I love you next best to father.  <sub>[v4 c23 P4](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0004)</sub>
